name: Cube UI Kit
summary: Open-source React Aria kit with 100+ components and a token-aware Tasty style engine.
gaps: Storybook iframe demos (SPA); story IDs are actions-*/forms-*/overlays-* docs paths, not short slugs.
Requires Root provider + Tasty/Glaze token system (not drop-in unstyled).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Primary action button with React Aria press handling.

demo.peerNotes: Styled React Aria kit (MIT) with Tasty tokens. Storybook hosts live interactive demos + docs. Wrap app in Root.

copyPrompt.text: Use Cube UI Kit free MIT React primitive `Button` (slug `button`) from https://cube-ui-kit.vercel.app/?path=/docs/actions-button--docs. Install with `pnpm add @cube-dev/ui-kit (or npm/yarn)`. Import from `@cube-dev/ui-kit`. Wrap with `Root`. Home: https://cube-ui-kit.vercel.app/. Docs: https://cube-ui-kit.vercel.app/?path=/docs/actions-button--docs. Repo: https://github.com/cube-js/cube-ui-kit. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cube-js/cube-ui-kit/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2024 Cube Dev, Inc.). Pricing free.
